catalog_note: Version-2 catalog on Azure/ARO-HCP main at the frozen commit, before the INT uksouth shard0 retirement (24 pools, 138 slots).
release_note: openshift/release main f3e648f6fe08 plus the unmerged B0 change (draft PR openshift/release#89449, INT ALLOWED_LOCATIONS -> MULTISTAGE_PARAM_OVERRIDE_LOCATION), because B0 merges before Phase A.
caller_count_note: legacy-callers-generator.py.txt reproduces the originally recorded 54 (31 build, 23 import) at openshift/release 81a17df231958bc893175ee2ab18eaf55e0b162d; the 56 here are the same scope at the later revision.
generator: go run ./cmd/<harness> <catalog.yaml> <legacy-callers.json> from a checkout of catalog_commit; harness = legacy-golden-generator.go.txt (main.go) and legacy-region-generator.go.txt (region.go, declarations extracted verbatim from acquire.go at catalog_commit); no new implementation used

determinism.mock_identity_bundle: fixed UUID/certificate fixture (a1000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000N) for slots that declare mock_identities
determinism.asset_lease_outcome: first UnitsPerSlot inventory resources in index order
determinism.runtime_region: raw slot region when nonempty; westus3 otherwise (export/state fixture, not weighted selection)
determinism.state_validation: ValidateForAdmission (state before admission output is published)

reproduction: git worktree add --detach <dir> <catalog_commit>; add test/cmd/zz-golden-gen/{main.go,region.go} from the two .go.txt harnesses.
python3 legacy-callers-generator.py.txt <release-repo> <rev> legacy-callers.json (needs a release checkout containing the B0 change).
